strengths: Bold visual presence with strong headline typography
Clear contact section with an integrated contact form and direct phone/email information
Logical visual separation of page content sections

issues.issue: Unreadable dark red text on bright red background in 'OUR MISSION' section
issues.description: The body text inside the 'OUR MISSION' section uses a dark red font color over a vibrant red background, severely failing accessibility standards and rendering the text nearly invisible.
issues.recommendation: Change the paragraph text color to white (#FFFFFF) to ensure high contrast and readability against the red background.

target.text: TagTeamSigns was established in 2001 to make the process of purchasing high quality...

issues.issue: Missing prominent Call-to-Action (CTA) in Hero section
issues.description: The top hero banner displays large text but lacks any actionable primary button (e.g., 'Get a Quote' or 'Contact Us'), missing a key opportunity to convert primary visitors.
issues.recommendation: Add a prominent primary CTA button below 'SIGNS DESIGN BUILD INSTALL' leading directly to the estimate or contact form.

issues.issue: Low contrast bullet text over background image in 'WHO WE ARE'
issues.description: The red bulleted list in the 'WHO WE ARE' section is placed over a light grayscale background image, causing poor contrast and reduced legibility.
issues.recommendation: Place the text list over a solid white or semi-opaque light background container, or use a darker, contrasting text color.

issues.issue: Unlabeled service icons in 'OUR SERVICES' section
issues.description: The 'OUR SERVICES' section displays four tiny red icons on a dark gray background with no accompanying labels, text, or links, offering zero contextual value to the user.
issues.recommendation: Add clear text titles and short service descriptions under each icon, and increase icon size and contrast.

issues.issue: Low contrast and small font size in header navigation
issues.description: The header navigation links use a thin, small white font over the bright red top bar, making navigation items difficult to scan quickly.
issues.recommendation: Increase the header navigation font size and font weight for better legibility and target spacing.

target.text: HOME SERVICES ABOUT US WORK CONTACT

issues.issue: Overuse of highly saturated red backgrounds causing visual fatigue
issues.description: Large full-width blocks of saturated red are repeated across multiple sections (Hero, Our Work, Our Mission), creating visual fatigue and overwhelming the user.
issues.recommendation: Use red primarily as an accent color for CTAs, headings, and key highlights while using neutral white or off-white for full section backgrounds.

issues.description: The footer displays '© 2020 by TAGTEAMSIGNS', which gives users the impression that the business or website is no longer actively maintained.
issues.recommendation: Update the copyright notice to the current year dynamically using JavaScript.
